description: Ampelkreuzungen 2022 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltkarten-niedersachsen.de. Digital nationwide database of the relevant light-sign-regulated nodes, which are used to calculate the noise maps 2022 according to the EU Environmental Noise Directive (2002/49/EC, 34. BImSchV) is used. The factual data set contains the relevant attributes for each element for a noise calculation according to BUB (calculation method for ambient noise from near-ground sources). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic light intersections 2022" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2015-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
